As someone who has already lived through their twenties and early thirties, let me tell you a secret: nobody has it all together, especially when they are young. I used to cry myself to sleep thinking I was too broken to ever be loved or successful. But life surprised me once I stopped being so harsh on myself. Eat good food, sleep early, step outside to feel the sun on your skin, and never stop being curious about the world. Build your skills, protect your peace, and speak to yourself like someone you deeply care about. It took time, but I built a life filled with honest friendships, a loving home, and a career I am proud of out of pure rock bottom. Your story isn't over yet, darling. The best chapters are still waiting to be written.
